description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from 100% cotton with a 260 GSM heavyweight fabric for enhanced durability and everyday comfort.
    - Crafted using 16-count combed cotton, offering a softer, smoother texture with excellent breathability.
    - Comfortable, skin-friendly, and suitable for year-round wear.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes from S to 5XL.
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1–3 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using DTF (Direct-to-Film) technology for vibrant colors, sharp details, and long-lasting print quality.
     
  • Care Instructions:
    -Machine wash or hand wash, inside out, with similar colors
    - Use mild detergent. Do not bleach.
    - Tumble dry low or hang dry.
    - Do not iron directly on the printed design.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for everyday casual wear, work, school, travel, and outdoor activities.
    - Heavyweight yet durable construction provides lasting comfort throughout the day.
    - Ideal for personalized designs, custom artwork, business branding, events, clubs, and promotional apparel.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A personalized Classic T-Shirt makes a thoughtful gift for birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, graduations, family reunions, holidays, or any special occasion. A meaningful keepsake for family members, friends, coworkers, and anyone who appreciates comfortable everyday fashion with a personal touch.

 

  • Brand: No Brand


SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Packaging: 1x Unisex Washed T-shirt

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups  here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
